entries.title: Leviticus 8:1
segments: The Lord spake unto Moses; after the tabernacle was finished, and the way prepared for the consecration of Aaron and his sons to the priesthood.

entries.title: Leviticus 8:5
segments: The thing which the Lord commanded;

entries.title: Leviticus 8:9
segments: If the ministers of religion are comely in the sight of God, or in any measure fitted for their work, it must be through the comeliness which he puts upon them--clothing them with his righteousness, and adorning them with the graces of his Spirit.

entries.title: Leviticus 8:12
segments: Sanctify him; set him apart, or consecrate him to his sacred office.

entries.title: Leviticus 8:14
segments: Even those who are the most solemnly consecrated to the service of God are themselves sinners, and need the cleansing of atoning blood.

entries.title: Leviticus 8:30
segments: In every thing sinners need the purifying influences of the Holy Spirit, in order to offer acceptable sacrifice to a holy God, or be prepared for his presence.

entries.title: Leviticus 8:34
segments: As he hath done this day; or, as it hath been done this day.  Each of the seven days he was to offer sacrifice, as he had the first day.

entries.title: Leviticus 8:36
segments: Ministers of religion who have a right spirit, will feel deeply the responsibilities of their office; that they are called to it not merely by men, but by God; and will labor first of all to please him by seeking his glory and doing his will.
